about: WP71: four readings for holdout-3's short documents (development data since its exam), standard profile only, each its own switch (infer.WP71_RULES); the Google Docs profile is byte-identical. Item 2: right-tab fields a blank template sets (identical fields need no rag; a banner centred across the middle and the right item of a two-up list are no field; one long field beside white is a field). Item 3: a grid of pictures over captions (a letter's signature pages), read before the float passes and before any column test, one borderless layout row per grid row, the pictures anchored. Item 4: a small margin label heads the line it stands beside; a full line indented on the left is not right-aligned unless a paragraph beside it is (not a row of cells). Item 1: a URL broken inside at the line's edge joins with nothing, zero-width break opportunities after / ? & = in it.
